disposition: Cleared to install only the exact reviewed bootstrap IAM roles, OIDC provider and private state bucket
scope_excludes: Substituting for the required human deployment approval
controls_reviewed: Exact immutable repository-and-environment OIDC subjects and STS audience; separate prepare and execute identities.
Preparation cannot update services or execute change sets; execution cannot prepare change sets, pass roles or publish images.
Change-set permissions bind the exact stack and supported ChangeSetName conditions. Preparation also binds the restricted execution role and private template URL.

The separate CloudFormation role has fixed task-family, service, service-deployment, schedule and PassRole boundaries, with required wildcard permissions only where the AWS API has no resource-level support.
No role receives secret mutation, database mutation, IAM administration or object/version deletion authority.

The state bucket is versioned, encrypted, owner-enforced, publicly blocked and TLS-only. State writes require conditional headers; immutable promotion writes require If-None-Match. Object and version deletion are explicitly denied.
findings_repaired_and_reread: CloudFormation authorizes change-set operations against the stack, so a changeset ARN in the Resource list alone did not restrict execution. Supported name conditions now enforce the intended prefix.
ECS task-definition description/deregistration and ELB target-health reads now use the resource model supported by AWS; an unsupported UpdateService cluster condition was removed.

RegisterTaskDefinition is restricted to existing task families. Current CloudFormation resource-handler dependencies for deployment inspection, stopping and tag reads were added with the supported fixed scopes.
limitations: IAM simulation and static validation do not prove a live deployment succeeds. Actual installed policy readback, OIDC assumption and the real approved promotion remain required.
Private resource identifiers, complete policies, raw AWS responses and tenant state remain outside public evidence.
